        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/inventory_management",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/inventory_management.json",
          "text": "Inventory Management",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.title",
          "label": "Inventory Management",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/inventory_management",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/inventory_management.json",
          "text": "So you've got a few Vessels and you've made a few Wooden Chests, but you still have more items than you know what to do with. What's next? A Backpack can double your on-person inventory at base level, and further backpack upgrades increase it even more!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Inventory Management",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/inventory_management",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/inventory_management.json",
          "text": "Backpacks can carry multiple heavy items without encumbering you, as well as big items like stacks of logs. You can even upgrade it with a Crafting Upgrade to have a Crafting Table with you everywhere.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Inventory Management",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/inventory_management",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/inventory_management.json",
          "text": "For storage, GregTech has Crates which can hold all the bigger items a backpack can, and different tiers can hold more and more items. Crates can also have Item Filters and Item Tag Filters put on them if you'd like to make a basic sorting system. Item Pipes don't pull by themselves though, so you'll need a Chute or Hopper to push into them.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Inventory Management",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/inventory_management",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/inventory_management.json",
          "text": "For storing fluids, GregTech has Drums. These can hold a large amount of a single fluid type, and different tiers hold more, just like with crates. Unlike crates, drums will retain their fluid when broken, making them ideal for moving fluids around. Drums can automatically push their fluid out of their bottom face by right-clicking them with a Soft Mallet or Screwdriver.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.text",
          "label": "Inventory Management",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/inventory_management",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/inventory_management.json",
          "text": "Place the drum in a crafting grid to clear its contents.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.5.text",
          "label": "Inventory Management",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,

          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/oxygen_distributor",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/oxygen_distributor.json",
          "text": "Using the Distributor",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.title",
          "label": "Oxygen Distributor",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 7
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/oxygen_distributor",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/oxygen_distributor.json",
          "text": "Once you have supplied the oxygen distributor with an infinite water source, sufficient energy and a completely sealed room, it will distribute oxygen in that room. To check that oxygen is being distributed, click \"show\" in the distributor GUI. If the room is highlighted, that means that the oxygen has been successfully distributed.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Oxygen Distributor",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 7
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/oxygen_distributor",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/oxygen_distributor.json",
          "text": "If there is a hole in your structure that is causing oxygen to escape, the distributor GUI will provide a warning. Patch the hole to avoid unnecessary power draw and oxygen usage. After that, you should be able to take off your oxygen suit and survive. Each oxygen distributor can support up to 6,000 blocks, allowing you to build a moderately sized space station or base. If you need more, you can place more oxygen distributors.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.text",
          "label": "Oxygen Distributor",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 7
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/oxygen_distributor",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/oxygen_distributor.json",
          "text": "Inside your oxygenated structure, you should provide proper ventilation to ensure that oxygen does not get blocked when a door is closed. To do this, you can create a one-block gap in between walls or use a vent block to allow oxygen flow.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.5.text",
          "label": "Oxygen Distributor",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 7
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/oxygen_distributor",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/oxygen_distributor.json",
          "text": "Rapid depressurization",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.6.title",
          "label": "Oxygen Distributor",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 7
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/oxygen_distributor",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/oxygen_distributor.json",
          "text": "When your structure is fully sealed, and a hole is created, your structure will rapidly depressurize. This can be a catastrophic event. All entities inside will be violently sucked out of the hole and die without a space suit. The oxygen distributor will also rapidly drain oxygen and power. Avoid this by patching holes as soon as possible and by preventing accidental holes from being created.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.6.text",
          "label": "Oxygen Distributor",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 7
        }

          "text": "Steel Pumps and Steel Pipes are blocks useful for transporting fluids, such as Water, Salt Water, and Spring Water. They can also be used to move source blocks, and fill small enclosed areas. Unlike Aqueducts, they can also be used to transport source blocks upwards.",

          "label": "Pumps",
          "item_ref_count": 5,

          "text": "The steel pipe can be crafted from, predictably, Steel, on an Anvil. A Steel Pump can be crafted from some Steel Pipes, and Brass Mechanisms.",

          "label": "Pumps",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 4

          "text": "In order to operate the pump, you will also need a Crankshaft, and a source of Mechanical Power: - The pump must be connected on the bottom to a pipe.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Pumps",

          "text": "- On the narrow side, the pump must be adjacent to the business end of a Crankshaft. - The pump can reach up to 16 blocks.
